title: Derived tensor and open restriction in independent universes
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and U an arbitrary open. Give D(O_X) and D(O_U) independently chosen localizations [def-pc-derived-category] and the derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. For arbitrary E,F in D(O_X), exact restriction R (the over functor followed by the over equivalence) satisfies R(E tensor-derived F) is isomorphic to R(E) tensor-derived R(F). No quasi-coherence or boundedness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Lemma 36.3.9, proof of (1), locality and the K-flat computation (2); Tag 08DV for tilde K-flatness

proof.text: Choose a K-flat first representative P and arbitrary second representative N. Exact open restriction preserves P’s K-flatness. Restriction commutes degreewise with sheaf tensor, arbitrary coproducts, and both differentials in totalization. Thus the total restricted tensor computes both sides by the K-flat counit comparison.

Transport this comparison across the canonical equivalences between localizations. These equivalences identify Q of every complex, and hence the K-flat tensor computations; the localization universal property extends the isomorphism to all pairs of derived objects.
